There seems to be a bug in the version of banshee included in Mint 18 that renders large libraries (10,000+ songs) unusable. The larger the library the longer it takes for Banshee to start, and the more likely it is to freeze if you try to switch songs.

My song library is over 27,000 songs and takes over 8 minutes to load. The solution was simple.

1) Download the Banshee 2.9.0 .deb here.

2) uninstall or purge banshee, ex.:

sudo apt-get purge banshee

3) install downloaded banshee 2.9.0 deb.

4) import library ( if you haven't already, your config files should still be there from the first install).

5) Jam.
A heads up to anyone experiencing problems with Banshee on Linux Mint 18.

Just remember that the .deb file you download will never be updated by the system, so if they release a fix for this then you wont get it or further updates down the road, unless you reinstall Banshee either with the terminal or another way.

Banshee also has Mono as a dependency and there are some who don't like having that on their system as well.
